title: Meta Share Price Trends Following Q2 Earnings Report
description: Meta's share price has been trending following the release of its Q2 2026 earnings report, which showed a stock plunge of almost 10% according to CNBC.

sources.title: Meta's stock plunges almost 10% on disappointing guidance, dwindling free cash flow
Meta shares tumble as Mark Zuckerberg tries to sell his vision for AI ‘agents’

sections.heading: Earnings Report Overview
paragraphs: The Q2 2026 earnings report for Meta has been a significant event, with its share price plunging almost 10% as reported by CNBC. This decline is attributed to disappointing guidance and dwindling free cash flow.

sections.heading: Market Reaction
paragraphs: The market's reaction to Meta's earnings report has been largely negative, with shares tumbling as detailed in the Financial Times article.

sections.heading: AI Vision and Impact
paragraphs: The Guardian reports that Meta missed earnings forecasts after Mark Zuckerberg's media push to promote AI, which seems to have had an impact on investor confidence.

faq.q: What happened to Meta's share price after the Q2 earnings report?
faq.a: Meta's share price plunged almost 10% after the release of its Q2 2026 earnings report, as reported by CNBC.

faq.q: What factors contributed to the decline in Meta's share price?
faq.a: The decline was due to disappointing guidance and dwindling free cash flow, as well as missing earnings forecasts after Mark Zuckerberg's push to promote AI, according to CNBC and The Guardian.
